A '''braised mushroom''' is a cooked brown [[mushroom]]. It heals {{Value|Braised Mushroom|heals}}, is eaten quickly and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/braised_brown_mushroom.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A brown mushroom cooks into a braised mushroom in an [[oven]] in {{Value|Braised Mushroom|cook_time|station=Oven}} or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Braised Mushroom|cook_time|station=Kindling}}. Picking up a brown mushroom unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a braised mushroom takes {{Value|Braised Mushroom|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Braised Mushroom|heals}}.

Obtaining a braised mushroom unlocks [[Pickled Mushrooms|pickled mushrooms]] and [[stroganoff]]. It is also used in [[Mushroom Pizza|mushroom pizza]] and [[bokguk]].
